body:
NOCK's video editor (renamed 'MIXFORGE EDITOR' per founder branding direction) is now PARENA-wasm powered: PARENA/stdlib/video/nle.prn compiles to frontend/nock/src/video/nle.wasm via MIXFORGE's own build pipeline, and video/nleEngine.ts + video/waveform.ts are direct ports of MIXFORGE/web/engine.mjs + waveform.mjs (the literal 'shares components with MIXFORGE' ask). Real non-linear editing: Segment gained TransitionMS/FadeInMS/FadeOutMS, validated+clamped in internal/nock/video_store.go, computed identically in a live client-side preview (TimelinePreview.tsx) and the server ffmpeg render (new xfade/acrossfade/fade filter path, renderWithTransitions). New MPC pad-capture panel in ClipViewer pulls clips live off a playing stream (quick-grab + press-and-hold), a third acquisition path alongside upload and manual mark-in/mark-out. go build/vet/test clean (3 new tests, 2 ffmpeg-gated and honestly skipped in this sandbox), tsc -b && vite build clean, 14/14 nle.wasm kernel checks pass. Commit 5579ad4.

⚓ ☃
title: MIXFORGE EDITOR: PARENA-wasm non-linear video editing + MPC clip capture in NOCK
